tasks.task: I need to buy a Wireless Mouse from the Acme Store product page, but our QA policy says we must proceed only if there are no console errors after adding the item. Please open the product page, add the Wireless Mouse to the cart (confirm the dialog if prompted), then check the browser console for errors and report the error count before closing the session.

success_criteria: A dialog with message "Add Wireless Mouse to your cart?" is accepted (tool return indicates result "handled").
Console errors are fetched with onlyErrors=true and the returned payload includes a numeric count field (e.g., $3.returned.count).
The browser session is closed successfully (tool return indicates "browser closed").

tasks.task: I’m preparing a bug report for the Acme Store product page “Wireless Mouse” and need to capture the current JavaScript errors before end of day. Please open the product page, reproduce the “Add Wireless Mouse to your cart?” confirmation and accept it, then collect only console errors and close the browser session. Make sure the recorded errors include the POST /api/reviews failure if it appears.

success_criteria: browser_console_messages returns count >= 1 and includes at least one message with type="error"
The console error list includes the entry "Network error: POST /api/reviews failed with 503" (if present during the run), and is explicitly visible in the returned messages
browser_handle_dialog returns dialog.message equal to "Add Wireless Mouse to your cart?" and result="handled" with accept=true

tasks.task: Please reproduce and document the checkout bug on the Acme Store product page for “Wireless Mouse” before today EOD: open the product page, try adding it to the cart (accept any confirmation dialog), then capture any JavaScript console errors that appear. If the browser isn’t installed yet, install Chromium first. I need the final list of console errors as evidence.

success_criteria: The page was resized to 1280x720 (browser_resize confirms width=1280 and height=720).
Console errors are returned after the add-to-cart attempt (browser_console_messages returns count > 0).
The final step returns the parsed list of error messages from the console output (derived from step 4’s returned payload).
